title: Second lesson receipt
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE extremely polished full-screen Hangul Sori mobile app mockup, not a comparison sheet. Portrait aspect ratio 402:874; the entire canvas is the app screen, no phone casing, no outside margins. Output high resolution. Image 1 is the USER-SELECTED C design: preserve its recognizable deep jade lacquer texture, sculpted jade cloud relief at the outer edges, warm ivory sans-serif hierarchy, engraved gold/brass dimensional numerals, warm hanji information card, gold primary CTA and jade secondary CTA. Keep the same visual quality and component family. Image 2 is the authentic Yeopjeon coin reference: square central hole, thick worn brass rim, historic embossed face. Use this as the hero currency, not generic western coins. If Image 3 is supplied, it is the user's gold-coin shower, a restrained supporting reward effect.
Change the central subject completely: NO Dokkaebi, NO people, NO club. Design a currency-focused scene with convincing 3D depth, an upper-left warm key light, shallow material bevels, realistic contact shadow and restrained teal sparkle.
Logical geometry: top system region y0-62 containing only 9:41, island, signal/wifi/battery. Brand HANGUL SORI and wallet pill BELOW it at y66-112. Title and reason y124-184. Central content y196-702. Primary button x20,y714,w362,h56; secondary x20,y778,w362,h48. Bottom y840-874 remains safe jade background, with a small white home indicator. These are one-screen compositions: no scrolling, no cutoff bottom controls, no excessive empty middle. Related text gaps 4-8, groups12-16. CTA text fits on ONE line, with an independent right-chevron zone 44px wide, never overlapping decorative clouds or raised borders. Raised button base is part of the button height; button corners and cloud details must match Image1.
Typography must be sharp, readable, high contrast and German only except brand and currency name. Use exact supplied copy, no extra fake captions, debug controls or floating +++ labels. Keep numbers and text off the busy currency artwork. NO buildings, roofs, silhouettes, blueprints, stage sequences, fabric covers, chest, ribbons, curtains, timeline, fixed Sarangchae label or white rectangular artwork backdrop. The unrevealed next building art is never shown.
Screen: a confirmed SECOND lesson reward, before wallet20, earned10, final wallet30. It has NOT unlocked a building step yet. This is a happy smaller reward, not a readiness announcement.
Exact copy and layout:
header wallet coin icon + "30".
title "Lektion geschafft"; subtitle "Deine zweite Lektion heute".
At y200-288, large dimensional "+10", small authentic coin beside it, label "Yeopjeon".
At y300-538, one large tilted authentic coin standing on a low jade contact plane, surrounded by 4-6 smaller coins and a brief gold sparkle sweep. It replaces the actor with a proper focal scene, neither a flat icon nor a giant empty gap.
At y558-702, ONE warm hanji card with a brass book medallion at left. Text "Dein Ildu-Haus", "Neue Bauschritte durchs Lernen". Clear compact last row "Gesammelt: 30" and "Baukosten: 40" with small coin marks. Do not put a readiness check or claim that 10 more coins alone unlocks anything.
Primary gold CTA "Weiterlernen"; secondary jade "Zum Ildu-Haus".
All copy fits its surface without touching the metallic card rim.
